pairs: when king Hezekiah had heard this,
and he wrapped himself in sackcloth,
and he entered the house of the Lord.
and the elders of the priests,
This day is a day of tribulation, and of rebuke,
dies hæc; quia venerunt filii usque ad partum,
For the sons have arrived at the time for birth,
but there is not enough strength to bring them forth.

Si quomodo audiat Dominus Deus tuus verba Rabsacis, quem misit rex Assyriorum dominus suus ad blasphemandum Deum viventem et exprobrandum sermonibus quos audivit Dominus Deus tuus: leva ergo orationem pro reliquiis quæ repertæ sunt.

Perhaps, somehow, the Lord your God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of the Assyrians, his lord, has sent to blaspheme the living God, and will rebuke the words that the Lord your God has heard. Therefore, lift up your prayers on behalf of the remnant which has been left behind.”
Et venerunt servi regis Ezechiæ ad Isaiam.
And so the servants of king Hezekiah went to Isaiah.
“You shall say this to your lord:
Ne timeas a facie verborum quæ audisti,
Do not be afraid to face the words that you have heard,
quibus blasphemaverunt pueri regis Assyriorum me.
by which the servants of the king of the Assyrians blasphemed me.
Behold, I will send a spirit to him,
and he will hear a message,
and he will return to his own land.
et corruere eum faciam gladio in terra sua.
And I will cause him to fall by the sword, in his own land.”
et invenit regem Assyriorum præliantem adversus Lobnam:
and he found the king of the Assyrians fighting against Libnah.
audierat enim quia profectus esset de Lachis.
For he had heard that he had set out from Lachish.
Et audivit de Tharaca rege Æthiopiæ,
Egressus est ut pugnet contra te.
“He has gone forth so that he may fight against you.”
And when he had heard this,
Non te decipiat Deus tuus in quo tu confidis,
Do not let your God, in whom you trust, deceive you by saying:
dicens: Non dabitur Jerusalem in manu regis Assyriorum.
‘Jerusalem will not be given into the hands of the king of the Assyrians.’
Ecce tu audisti omnia quæ fecerunt reges Assyriorum omnibus terris, quas subverterunt:
Behold, you have heard about all that the kings of the Assyrians have done to all the lands that they have conquered,
and so, how can you be delivered?
Numquid eruerunt eos dii gentium quos subverterunt patres mei,
Have the gods of the nations rescued those whom my fathers have conquered:
et filios Eden qui erant in Thalassar?
and the sons of Eden who were at Telassar?
Where is the king of Hamath
or the king of the city of Sepharvaim,
Et tulit Ezechias libros de manu nuntiorum,
And Hezekiah took the letter from the hand of the messengers,
and he went up to the house of the Lord,
et expandit eos Ezechias coram Domino:
and Hezekiah spread it out in the sight of the Lord.
And Hezekiah prayed to the Lord,
the God of Israel who sits upon the Cherubim:
you alone are God of all the kingdoms of the earth.
tu es Deus solus omnium regnorum terræ:
et vide: et audi omnia verba Sennacherib,
And hear all the words of Sennacherib,
quæ misit ad blasphemandum Deum viventem.
which he has sent to blaspheme the living God.
the kings of the Assyrians have laid waste to countries
And they have cast their gods into the fire.
but the works of men’s hands,
And they broke them into pieces.
et cognoscant omnia regna terræ quia tu es Dominus solus.
And let all the kingdoms of the earth acknowledge that you alone are Lord.”
“Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel:
Pro quibus rogasti me de Sennacherib,
Because of what you have prayed to me about Sennacherib,
hoc est verbum quod locutus est Dominus super eum:
this is the word that the Lord has spoken over him:
Despexit te et subsannavit te, virgo filia Sion;
The virgin daughter of Zion has despised you and mocked you.
post te caput movit, filia Jerusalem.
The daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you.
And against whom have you lifted up your voice
and raised up your eyes on high?
Against the Holy One of Israel!
In manu servorum tuorum exprobrasti Domino,
By the hand of your servants, you have reproached the Lord.
In multitudine quadrigarum mearum ego ascendi altitudinem montium juga Libani;
‘With a multitude of my four-horse chariots, I have ascended the heights of the mountains adjoining Lebanon.
et succidam excelsa cedrorum ejus, et electas abietes illius,
And I will cut down its lofty cedars and its choice pine trees.
And I will reach the top of its summit,
to the forest of its Carmel.
et exsiccavi vestigio pedis mei omnes rivos aggerum.
and I dried up all the river banks with the sole of my foot.’
Numquid non audisti quæ olim fecerim ei?
Have you not heard what I have done to it in past times?
Ex diebus antiquis ego plasmavi illud;
In ancient times, I formed it. And now I have brought it forth.
et nunc adduxi, et factum est in eradicationem collium compugnantium,
And it has been made so that the hills and the fortified cities would fight together,
They became like the plants of the field,
and the grass of the pastures,
and like the weeds on the rooftops,
which wither before they are mature.
When you became angry against me,
superbia tua ascendit in aures meas.
your arrogance rose up to my ears.
Ponam ergo circulum in naribus tuis,
Therefore, I will place a ring in your nose,
and a bit between your lips.
et reducam te in viam per quem venisti.
And I will turn you back on the road by which you arrived.
But this shall be a sign for you: Eat,
comede hoc anno quæ sponte nascuntur,
in this year, whatever springs up on its own.
et in anno secundo pomis vescere;
And in the second year, eat fruits.
in anno autem tertio seminate et metite,
But in the third year, sow and reap,
Et mittet id quod salvatum fuerit de domo Juda,
And what will be saved from the house of Judah,
For from Jerusalem, a remnant shall go forth,
The zeal of the Lord of hosts will accomplish this.
Propterea hæc dicit Dominus de rege Assyriorum:
For this reason, thus says the Lord about the king of the Assyrians:
He will not enter this city,
nor shoot an arrow into it,
nor overtake it with a shield,
et non mittet in circuitu ejus aggerem.
nor dig a rampart all around it.
He will return on the road by which he arrived.
And I will protect this city,
so that I may save it for my own sake,
and for the sake of David,
Then the Angel of the Lord went forth and struck down,
et percussit in castris Assyriorum centum octoginta quinque millia.
in the camp of the Assyrians, one hundred eighty-five thousand.
And they arose in the morning,
and behold, all these were dead bodies.
et abiit, et reversus est Sennacherib,
the king of the Assyrians, departed and went away.
rex Assyriorum, et habitavit in Ninive.
And he returned and lived at Nineveh.
cum adoraret in templo Nesroch deum suum,
as he was adoring his god in the temple of Nisroch,
And they fled into the land of Ararat.
